name: Quick Mart PLC
source: Quick Mart PLC Information Memorandum, Initial Public Offering, 02 October 2026 (Nairobi Securities Exchange listing 12 November 2026). Figures read from the text layer of the published PDF, section 'Selected Historical Financial Information': statement of profit or loss (printed page 117), statement of financial position (printed page 119), statement of cash flow (printed page 120). Conformed from the Reporting Accountants Report; the memorandum states the FY2021 to FY2025 columns are audited and the 30 June 2026 column unaudited. The memorandum reports KES thousands; every value here is x1000, whole Kenya Shillings. No projected column is included. Profit or loss figures for FY2025 and FY2024 also agree to the company's audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 read separately. The three balance sheet identities tie in every period, as do Revenue less Cost of Sales against Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax less Income Tax against Net Profit.
units_note: The Information Memorandum reports KES thousands. Values here are whole Kenya Shillings, which is what every other security in this tree holds and what the panel renders.
